name: chart
need: Show a share, a figure per day or week, or a trend at a glance

--ds-meter-height.description: `.ds-meter`: the base height, 1px per size step (its rest radius is half of it)

--ds-columns-height.description: the plot of `.ds-columns` at size md, comfortable density: 24px per size step, 12px per density step (`--mini`: 32px)

--ds-columns-radius.description: the rounded data end of a column (times `--ds-shape`)

--ds-columns-group-min.description: the least width of a group of `.ds-columns--grouped`

--ds-chart-color.description: the colour of a column or a legend key

--ds-legend-key-size.description: the key of a `.ds-legend` entry, 2px per size step

--ds-chart-forced-ink.description: the fills of columns and legend keys in forced colours; a component that lays them on a system fill of its own sets it

--ds-chart-height.description: the plot of a line, area, column, bar or combo `.ds-chart` at size md, comfortable density: 40px per size step, 16px per density step; 3/4 of it under 480px of chart width

--ds-chart-radial-height.description: the plot of a donut, pie or ring: 24px per size step, 8px per density step

--ds-chart-gauge-height.description: the plot of a gauge: 24px per size step, 8px per density step

--ds-chart-spark-height.description: a sparkline (it lines up with a figure; no size or density)

--ds-chart-bar.description: the widest bar of a column or bar chart, 4px per size step (a narrow band gives less)

--ds-chart-radius.description: the rounded data end of a bar (times `--ds-shape`); the frame's focus ring

--ds-chart-stroke.description: the line of a line, area or sparkline

--ds-chart-marker.description: a point's marker (circle, square, triangle, diamond by series), 2px per size step

--ds-chart-area-opacity.description: the wash of an area under its line

--ds-chart-stack-opacity.description: the fill of a stacked area

--ds-chart-dash-2.description: the dash of the line of series 2 (`none`: solid)

--ds-chart-dash-3.description: the dash of the line of series 3

--ds-chart-dash-4.description: the dash of the line of series 4

labExempt.DS.chart.ticks: a pure function of the chart engine: no motion
labExempt.DS.chart.timeTicks: a pure function of the chart engine: no motion
labExempt.DS.chart.scale: a pure function of the chart engine: no motion
labExempt.DS.chart.path: a pure function of the chart engine: no motion
labExempt.DS.chart.stack: a pure function of the chart engine: no motion
labExempt.DS.chart.nearest: a pure function of the chart engine: no motion
labExempt.DS.chart.parse: a pure function of the chart engine: no motion
labExempt.DS.chart.layout: a pure function of the chart engine: no motion

physical..ds-chart__centre: left: SVG coordinates: the module writes the centre of the arcs from the left of the plot, which is drawn left to right in every direction
physical..ds-chart__tip: left: SVG coordinates: the tooltip follows the cursor from the left of the plot, which is drawn left to right in every direction

morph..ds-chart__line: D14: a line morphs its d to new data on --ds-dur-glide and --ds-ease-value, from the frame on screen when interrupted
morph..ds-chart__area: D14: an area morphs with its line
morph..ds-chart__slice: D14: an arc of a donut or gauge morphs its angles to new data, from the frame on screen
